answer: The juniper multiplier is published, charged in lantern, and karst lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 3 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 2532 identities would post 2578 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
